english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Simple Family Plan
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: family & relationships — a simple family plan
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a simple family plan; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Mr Henry asks Ms Lan if they are visiting her parents this weekend.
context_note_vi: Anh Henry hỏi chị Lan cuối tuần này có ghé thăm bố mẹ chị không.

turns.speaker: Mr Henry
turns.english: Lan, are we visiting your parents this weekend?
turns.vietnamese: Lan này, cuối tuần này mình ghé thăm bố mẹ chị hả?

turns.speaker: Mr Henry
turns.english: Good, I am looking forward to it.
turns.vietnamese: Tốt, tôi mong đến lúc đó lắm.
